Closing a new client feels great until you have to hand the work over to delivery.

Too often, the handoff looks like this: a rushed Slack message, client files buried across email threads, and an ops team asking questions the client already answered two weeks ago.

It wastes billable hours and makes a shaky first impression.

A clean handoff doesn't require extra meetings. It requires connected tools.

When a deal marks "Closed Won" in your CRM:
• Your project management tool can generate the client workspace automatically.
• Internal shared folders and permissions can spin up instantly.
• An onboarding form can pre-populate with known deal data.

Your sales team moves on to the next deal, and your ops team gets every detail they need without chasing anyone.

How smooth is your sales-to-ops handoff?
